title: Lose a standing rule
description: A standing rule is suspended when the floored SPRT statistic over its recent outcomes reaches the line, log((1 - beta) / alpha) = log 19 at alpha and beta 0.05.

question.text: Should this standing rule be suspended?

evidence.sensor: the SPRT floored at 0, with p0 0.05 and p1 0.3 (operating-rules.json questions.loss)

sources.note: Overrides and corrections of the rule's answers (operating-rules.json signals.against)

scale.meaning: The floored sum of log likelihood ratios

note: The value is Math.log(19), the suspend threshold proved in packages/naive/lean/Naive/StandingRules.lean (suspendThresholdDefault_eq).
